method: Intersected unique SHA-256 values in this task's public_files and owner_files contracts, then inspected the corresponding numeric NPZ and profile JSON. No labels or Test score were read.

objects.kind: published membership and sampling profile metadata
objects.evidence: The profile contains source sequence memberships and the Bench sequence-sampling policy. Its top-level keys are schema, name, source_evaluator_sha, sampling, comparability, tasks, source_hashes, and agent_boundary; it contains no label_array field.

The public UserTrain file and a representative evaluator submission-pose file have identical bytes, SHA-256, NPZ member, shape, dtype, and zero nonzero elements. The other six evaluator paths have the same pinned SHA-256. No annotation, label, or probability array is present.

boundary: Only these two byte-identical, already-public contents are explicitly declared in the representation source-only evaluator lock. All other evaluator content, including every probe-training and Test label file, remains private. Dataset bytes, source membership, and task delivery revision are unchanged.
